$comment: The night-lights square over the US Midwest two hours after sunset: Chicago, Indianapolis, Columbus and the towns between lit, the last glow on the Earth's edge over the Great Plains beyond. The observer is on the great circle from Chicago away from the Sun, in the Earth's shadow, so the meter exposes for the night. A candidate for the night-lighting card, not published: the moonlit ground (the Moon is nearly full) or the distance leaves its lights less striking than south-east Brazil's.
name: night-lights-orbit-us-midwest
description: From 400 km over the south end of Lake Michigan at 01:00 UTC on 26 October 2026 (20:00 CDT), looking west-south-west across the lit towns of Illinois and Iowa to the last glow on the Earth's edge.
